newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Advance Synergy invests in gold miner.
newsitem.headline: Advance Synergy invests in gold miner.

text.p: Malaysia's Advance Synergy Bhd said one of its units is acquiring about 19.9 percent of Australasian Gold Mines NL through a stock purchase and a private placement.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Thursday, Advance Synergy said the proposed investment in the gold miner is through the acquisition of 850,000 ordinary shares in Australasian from SGJ Investments Pty Ltd in an off-market transaction at A$0.40 each or a total of A$341,020.

Advance Synergy's Synergy Gold Inc unit has also accepted an offer of a private placement of 14.5 million new ordinary shares in Australasian at A$0.50 each for a total of A$7.25 million, the statement said. It said its unit intends to finance the proposed investment through offshore borrowings.
Advance Synergy is involved in activities including property development, timber trading and making and selling plastic products.

Advance Synergy said that it will have representation on Australasian's three-member board, but did not say how many seats it would get. The proposed deal is subject to approvals of Australasian shareholders and Australia's Foreign Investment Review Board, the statement said.
